¿ (…) es: Rentista?........................... 1 Jubilado o pensionado?.... 2 Estudiante?....................... 3 Ama de casa?................... 4 Incapacitado?.................... 5 Otro, cuál? (Especifique)…… 6

¿La semana pasada que no tenía trabajo USTED, que actividades realizó: ... Ayudó o se dedicó a otras labores del hogar o la familia?..................................................................… 4

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not include unpaid domestic and care work within the definition of work or economic activity. Question 21 defines activities that count as work, restricting them to paid work, profit generation, or unpaid assistance to a family business/farm. Unpaid domestic work and care responsibilities are categorized as non-work or inactivity, such as 'Ama de casa' in Question 36 or 'Ayudó o se dedicó a otras labores del hogar o la familia' performed while without work in Section 4, Question 2.
